summary: Comprehensive test of the 4 kernel-closing features (Remediation Workflows, Policy Authoring, Kernel Health Telemetry, Weekly Drift Digest cron) plus regression on prior features. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASS (new file test_kernel_closing.py). Frontend UI: verified all data-testids present and interactive — 15 kernel-sub-* cards, 15 kernel-records-* fields, policy-new-btn + policy-modal (admin), policy-edit-POL-CTRL-EFFECT + modal, notif-bell → notif-panel → click control_drift item opens remediation-modal, remediation-accept works. Operational user correctly hidden from nav-platform-kernel and policy new/edit buttons; 403 on POST/PATCH /api/policies verified. Cleanup performed: POL-CTRL-EFFECT reset to 55, all POL-CUSTOM-* deleted, all remediation workflows deleted, weekly-digest notifications deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: kernel/health.py: risk_engine/control_engine 'last_run' hard-coded to 'live' string — inconsistent with numeric/timestamp fields elsewhere; could confuse UI parsers. Minor.
workflow.py start_remediation dedupe query uses status != 'resolved'; this is correct but any residual 'complete' workflows from onboarding type would not match because subject differs. OK.

policy.py create() generates policy_id from total org policy count — if any custom policy is deleted then created, IDs can collide (e.g. delete POL-CUSTOM-001 and next create is POL-CUSTOM-001 again). Consider UUID or a monotonic sequence.
scheduled.py _run_weekly_drift_digest catches per-org exceptions but not top-level DB errors — acceptable for cron.

kernel/routes.py remediate endpoint marks notification as read but does NOT set resolved:true until workflow is resolved — consistent with the assign flow but users may click the same notif twice; dedupe on workflow side handles it correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (verified: kernel-sub-* x15, kernel-records-* x15, policy-new-btn, policy-modal, policy-edit-POL-CTRL-EFFECT, policy-close, notif-bell, notif-panel, notif-item-* control_drift click opens remediation-modal, remediation-accept, remediation-assignee, remediation-assign, remediation-resolve, remediation-close, operational role gating on nav-platform-kernel + policy authoring)
